english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a hostile attitude or feeling towards someone.
This is the all-purpose choice for an openly hostile or aggressive attitude toward someone or a group.
Use this when the spite is expressed as an openly hostile attitude toward someone.
Use this when the malice is expressed as open hostility toward a person or group, rather than merely a hidden harmful intention.

examples.english: They are full of hostility toward the new neighbors and are always scowling.
examples.traditional: 佢對新搬嚟嘅鄰居充滿敵意，成日黑口黑面。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 san1 bun1 lai4 ge3 leon4 geoi1 cung1 mun5 dik6 ji3 seng4 jat6 hak1 hau2 hak1 min6

examples.english: He is full of belligerence toward the new colleague and keeps making sarcastic remarks.
examples.traditional: 佢對新同事充滿敵意，成日用說話挖苦人。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 san1 tung4 si6 cung1 mun5 dik6 ji3 seng4 jat6 jung6 syut3 waa6 waa1 fu2 jan4

examples.english: The two teams showed open hostility and spite from the moment they came out.
examples.traditional: 兩隊球員一出場就互相挑釁，場面充滿敵意。
examples.jyutping: loeng5 deoi6 kau4 jyun4 jat1 ceot1 coeng4 zau6 wu6 soeng1 tiu1 jan6 coeng4 min2 cung1 mun5 dik6 ji3

examples.english: The two community representatives immediately started accusing each other, and the room was full of malice.
examples.traditional: 兩個社區代表一見面就互相指責，現場充滿敵意。
examples.jyutping: loeng5 go3 se5 keoi1 doi6 biu2 jat1 gin3 min6 zau6 wu6 soeng1 zi2 zaak3 jin6 coeng4 cung1 mun5 dik6 ji3
